name: Type hero — DRIFT
description: Single hero word at display scale, flush-left, with mono subtitle anchored lower-right. The type-aware raked-light shader pass samples the captured text's alpha gradient (Sobel-style 4-tap central differences) and applies warm rim light to letterform edges facing the implied upper-left light + slight counter-shadow to edges facing away — type with dimension from raked theatrical light, not a uniform filter. Asymmetric composition + edge-aware shader work, neither of which the other demos have.
